cr-wabeno-bank-loot-1921.st: By July 1922 all but about $8,000 had been recovered; Lesperance, then serving a year at Waupun, was taken out by Sheriff Miller at the bank's expense for an all-day search and found nothing. The later 'never recovered' reports refer to that $8,000.
src: Green Bay Press-Gazette, 11 Jul 1922, p. 5, "Lesperance Fails to Unearth Money Taken From Bank"
